Central carbon metabolism including several (but not all) side pathways

Metabolites are depicted as brown boxes, enzymes as green letters or boxes, co-factors are indicated next to the arrows. Bidirectional arrows indicate reversible reactions, dashed lines refer to a path involving multiple enzymatic reactions that are not completely shown. ACC, Acetyl-CoA carboxylase; ACLY, ATP-citrate lyase; ACO, Aconitase; ADP, Adenosine diphosphate; ALDH4A1, Aldehyde dehydrogenase 4 family member A1; ALDO, Aldolase; ATP, Adenosine triphosphate; BP, Bisphosphate; CoA, Coenzyme A; CPT, Carnitine palmitoyltransferase; CS, Citrate synthase; ENO, Enolase; ETC, Electron transport chain; FAD, Flavin adenine dinucleotide; FADH2, Flavin adenine dinucleotide, reduced; FASN, Fatty acid synthase; FBP, Fructose bisphosphatase; FH, Fumarate hydratase; G6PD, Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase; GAPDH, Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase; GDP, Guanosine diphosphate; GLS, Glutaminase; GLUD, Glutamate dehydrogenase; GOT, Glutamate-oxaloacetate transaminase; GPT, glutamate-pyruvate transaminase; GS, Glutamine synthase; GTP, Guanosine triphosphate; HK, Hexokinase; IDH, Isocitrate dehydrogenase; LDH, Lactate dehydrogenase; MDH, Malate dehydrogenase; NAD+, Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, oxidized; NADH, Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, reduced; NADP+, Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate, oxidized; NADPH, Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate, reduced; OGDH, Oxoglutarate dehydrogenase; P, Phosphate; P5CS, Pyrroline-5-carboxylate synthase; PC, Pyruvate carboxylase; PDH, Pyruvate dehydrogenase; PCK, Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase; PFK, Phosphofructokinase; PGAM, Phosphoglycerate mutase; PGI, glucose-6-phosphate isomerase; PGK, Phosphoglycerate kinase; PHGDH, Phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase; PK, Pyruvate kinase; PRODH, Proline dehydrogenase; PSAT, Phosphoserine aminotransferase; PDPH, Phosphoserine phosphatase; PYCR, Pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase; SCS, Succinate-CoA synthetase; SDH, Succinate dehydrogenase, SDS, Serine dehydratase; SHMT, Serine hydroxymethyl transferase; THF, Tetrahydrofolate
